# Position control (`position-control`)

Open, stop, close and a position slider for blinds, gates, doors and valves.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createPositionControl` (types in `dist/web/home/positionControl.d.ts`): `.mh-position-control`: for blinds, shades, awnings, gates, garage doors and valves. `__buttons` holds `__button--open | --stop | --close` for what `can` allows (the one moving now is `.is-active` and its arrow drifts, unless reduced motion is asked for); `__slider` sets the position (100 = open) and sends it on release. States `.is-moving`, `.is-disabled`.

```ts
export function createPositionControl(options: PositionControlOptions): PositionControlHandle;

export interface PositionControlOptions {
  /** Accessible name of the whole control (default "Position"). */
  label?: string;
  state?: PositionState | null;
  /** 0 to 100, 100 fully open. */
  position?: number | null;
  /** Default: open and close. */
  can?: PositionCapabilities;
  labels?: Partial<PositionControlLabels>;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onOpen?: () => void;
  onClose?: () => void;
  onStop?: () => void;
  /** Sent when the finger lifts (not while dragging); a key press sends at once. */
  onPosition?: (value: number) => void;
}

export interface PositionControlHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** Applies changed options; omitted ones keep their value. A slider being dragged keeps the user's value. */
  update(changes: Partial<PositionControlOptions>): void;
  /** Sends a dragged value that was never released. */
  destroy(): void;
}

/** Every visible word, for translation ("Raise" / "Lower" for blinds). */
export interface PositionControlLabels {
  open: string;
  close: string;
  stop: string;
  position: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createPositionControl } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const blind = createPositionControl({
  label: 'Studio blind',
  state: 'stopped',
  position: 50,
  can: { open: true, close: true, stop: true, position: true },
  labels: { open: 'Raise', close: 'Lower' },
  onOpen: () => blind.update({ state: 'open', position: 100 }),
  onClose: () => blind.update({ state: 'closed', position: 0 }),
  onStop: () => blind.update({ state: 'stopped' }),
  onPosition: (position) => blind.update({ state: 'stopped', position }),
});

document.body.append(blind.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { PositionControl } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function PositionControlExample() {
  const [position, setPosition] = useState(50);
  return (
    <PositionControl
      label="Studio blind"
      state={position === 100 ? 'open' : position === 0 ? 'closed' : 'stopped'}
      position={position}
      can={{ open: true, close: true, stop: true, position: true }}
      labels={{ open: 'Raise', close: 'Lower' }}
      onOpen={() => setPosition(100)}
      onClose={() => setPosition(0)}
      onPosition={setPosition}
    />
  );
}
```
